Act 1's identity is read from the map screen, which titles it 'Underdocks'. This build ships two acts at index 0 - Overgrowth and Underdocks - and Overgrowth is the default, so taking the default would have replayed a different run. Acts 2 and 3 are not read from the video; the build ships exactly one variant at each of those indices, which is why the whole list is marked inferred rather than observed.

source.coverage: Run start through the first combat's opening turn: Neow's blessing, the move to the first map node, the two cards played on turn 1, and ending that turn. It stops there deliberately - this milestone is about whether a reconstructed history replays exactly, and extending the transcription further would add transcription risk without adding anything to that question.

evidence.method: Neow offers three options in a fixed order: Arcane Scroll, Lost Coffer, Leafy Poultice. Which one was taken is read from its effect rather than from the click: by t=31s max HP has gone 80 -> 68 (Leafy Poultice's -12) and two cards have been transformed, which no other option does.

actions.note: The transform produced two copies of Hellraiser. That is a specific random outcome, so reproducing it is a sharper test than reproducing the max-HP change.

evidence.method: the selected node is ringed on the map as the screen fades into the room; its position matches the centre column of row 1, which the generated map has as a Monster node
energy falls 3 -> 1 and the hand loses its second card; the played card's name floats above the player
energy falls 1 -> 0, the hand loses Defend, and 5 block appears beside the player's health bar. The hand index is 3 rather than 4 because playing Hellraiser already shifted the cards after it.
the turn ends with Strike, Strike and Bash unplayed; the enemy then attacks and the Turn 2 banner appears

actions.note: Hellraiser plays every drawn Strike against a random enemy, so the turn-2 draw consumes the combat-targets stream. This turn is squarely in the unforgiving class.
